text_block_list.text:
One day. Mejiro Dober had plans to go out
with Air Groove, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Urgent student council business... huh.
What should I do until Senpai gets here...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woooow, Dober!
What a coincidence, what are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Taiki... Umm,
I was supposed to hang out with
Air Groove-senpai, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I see! If that's the case, let's hang out
together! Come on, hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait, hold on—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, Dober! A new
gun action movie just arrived in stock!
Can we check out the lineup?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yeah. Sure, go ahead.
I'll wait here.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No, no! It's much more fun to look together!
By the way, what kind of movies do you like, Dober?
Heroes? Spies? Or maybe kung fu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez, all of those sound so noisy.
I prefer something more...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, what was the title again?
The movie Air Groove-senpai mentioned
that was "so striking it stayed with her"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was planning on watching it, but I totally forgot...
Even though Senpai went out of her way to recommend it to me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
OK! Then let's start by looking for that movie!
Do you think you can remember the title? What genre was it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It should be a relatively old foreign film, I think...
Wait, let me check my notes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... this book...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow!
Dober, you can play chess!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, less "play" and more...
I just played a match with Air Groove-senpai once before.
I was no match for her at all, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In that case, let's study chess
and give Air Groove a big surprise!
No time like the present, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, it's way deeper than I thought.
Still, maybe I'll try my best... and learn it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? Did I say something weird?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I'm just glad you're feeling all better, Dober, YES!
When we first met, you looked like the world was about to end, AFTER ALL!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...That's, I didn't really...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dober!
Forgive me, I'm late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Groove-senpai!
...And, um, who is that with you...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is an academy Trainer
who assisted me with my duties.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I could be of help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... see.
...Thank you for your hard work, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Thank you both for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm sorry I couldn't help out.
While you were working so hard, Senpai,
I was just goofing off...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm sorry I couldn't help out.
While you were working so hard, Senpai,
I was just goofing off...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, pay it no mind.
Taiki, thank you for looking after her. You have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! It was super-duper fun, YES!
I got to hear MANY, MANY stories about you, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? About me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's... Taiki, you're exaggerating.
I might have mentioned a few things, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Non, non!
Not just a few, it was a WHOLE BUNCH!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dober knew tons of things that Air Groove likes!
Such BIG LOVE, right♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Heh.
I'm honored.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not... Well, no, it's not wrong, but...
I really wasn't even thinking about it...!
choice_data_list: You really love Air Groove, huh?
You really love Air Groove, don't you?
It's great having someone you can look up to.
It's nice to have someone you can look up to, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not... Well, no, it's not wrong, but...
I really wasn't even thinking about it...!
choice_data_list: You really love Air Groove, huh?
You really love Air Groove, don't you?
It's great having someone you can look up to.
It's nice to have someone you can look up to, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-Urgh, be quiet...!
Don't act like you know everything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-Don't say it out loud, it's embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uuugh...! Could you please stop smiling like that...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. I'm really glad Air Groove-senpai is here...
